theorems.name: Submission.c1_regular_point_ball_image_isC1Submanifold
theorems.statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (G : Rn n → Rn p), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → ∀ x : Rn n, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ G x) → ∃ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ ∧ IsC1Submanifold n (G '' Metric.ball x σ)
